sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was raised materially: Q4 revenue guided to $65B ±2% versus the $61.66B consensus, a massive raise. Management also claimed visibility to $500B in Blackwell and Rubin revenue through end of calendar 2026, with explicit language that 'the number will grow.' The only deductions are the zeroing out of China data center revenue and rising input costs, but the overall forward signal is strongly positive.

summary.revenue: $57 billion, up 62% year over year, with sequential growth of $10 billion or 22%.
summary.eps: Non-GAAP EPS $1.30 vs $1.25 LSEG consensus (beat). GAAP EPS also $1.30.
summary.guidance: Q4 revenue expected to be $65 billion plus or minus 2%, implying 14% sequential growth at the midpoint. Management also stated visibility to a half a trillion dollars in Blackwell and Rubin revenue from the start of calendar 2025 through the end of calendar 2026.
summary.margin: GAAP gross margin 73.4%, non-GAAP gross margin 73.6%, both exceeding previous outlook. Q4 gross margin guided to mid-seventies. For fiscal 2027, management expects to hold gross margins in the mid-seventies despite rising input costs.
key_risks: China data center revenue is assumed to be zero in the Q4 outlook due to geopolitical issues and competitive market.
Rising input costs putting pressure on gross margins into fiscal 2027.
Inventory grew 32% quarter over quarter while supply commitments increased 63% sequentially, indicating large balance sheet bets.
Management is arguing against an AI bubble narrative, which is a defensive posture.
key_opportunities: Three massive platform shifts: CPU to GPU accelerated computing, generative AI, and agentic AI.
Data center revenue record $51 billion, up 66% year over year, driven by strong AI infrastructure demand.
Networking revenue $8.2 billion, up 162% year over year.
Blackwell architecture momentum with GB 300 now leading the product transition.
Strategic partnerships with Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS, Humane, and others, with up to 5 million GPUs associated with new AI factory projects.
Rubin platform on schedule for 2026 ramp with first silicon delivered.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management explicitly rebuts the AI bubble narrative ('There's been a lot of talk about an AI bubble. From our vantage point, we see something very different.') and provides strong forward guidance with visibility to $500 billion in revenue.
